enchantments.tooltip: Upgradeable - Tier 1: This item is a Tier 1 upgradable item.

children.tooltip: Armor Bonus +6: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +6 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
Glaciation +96: Passive: +96 Equipment bonus to Cold Spell Power.
Ice Lore +14: Passive: Your Cold spells gain a 14% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.

Fire Shield (Cold): When you are successfully attacked, there is a 10% chance that a Fire Shield (Cold) will be cast on you. If this effect activates while you have an active Fire Shield (Hot) from another item source, they will nullify each-other.
Enhanced Ki +1: Increases the rate at which the user gains ki with each successful attack.
